description: Existing Pactile installations move from generated Python task entrypoints to the Node CLI. The unpublished 0.5.1-beta.0 review-pool cleanup is included in this beta. Installed Python scripts are inventoried at update time because their recorded hashes vary by version and platform.
changelog: Node.js is the only required runtime. Run `pactile update --dry-run --json` to review replacements and legacy scripts, then `pactile update --skip-all --json` to preserve locally modified files while applying unchanged templates. Hash-verified retired Python files are removed after the Node generation is active; modified, skipped and unclaimed files remain on disk but are excluded from active generations. The retired review-pool skeleton is deleted only when its content matches a known Pactile template hash; user-authored pool items are preserved.

migrations.description: Retired review-pool items placeholder; user items are never targeted

notes: The pool migrations came from the unpublished 0.5.1-beta.0 preset. Hashes cover the original platform variants after CRLF normalization. No user-authored .pactile/pool/items/*.md is targeted. This manifest is preserved in stable 0.6.0 for direct upgrade paths.
